title: The merge tool records a fix check after a PASS round, then round 3 with no round 2, the path roles-review-cap-three names for a guard or check change
why: Coordinator 01:06 and 01:07 CST Nov 14 (relayed from batch runner 12, mailaudit #328 head 9a73d3f47c4a; lane review-carries-by-tree says its build does not cover this shape). Rule roles-review-cap-three: a guard or check change that got a fix verifier waits for round 3, and a passing round ends review, so round 1 PASS then fix check PASS then round 3 has no round 2. The tool has no record shape for it. Printed refusals (word for word as relayed): (1) "--round: the rounds must start at 1, rise by one at a time and stop at 3"; (2) "--fix-check: the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review log on this pull request, and that log must have no Fix check line or a PASS one ..."; (3) "this record restarts the review: ... has no fix verifier. A new branch with a new PR is the only way out." SIGHTING 2 02:06 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 02:05, from lane message 02:04 on claude-settings #3233, lane session_013NEJL12mvi6nBi2ykfbc9m; refusal quoted by the lane, the coordinator read only merge.py:4567-4569; unchecked by triage): the earlier record at head 5573ae05d held round 2 plus a Fix check; the lane then changed one text clause (owner 806 d) and merged main, new head 298179d858cb; a fresh round 1 PASS counts as fewer rounds, so `merge --review-record` exits 2 at the restart refusal. Shape: round 1 PASS on a NEW head after an earlier round 2 plus Fix check. The exception for a fix after a clean merge of main does not apply to a lane edit. Headline: a one-line text change after a passed round 2 forces three full rounds. Coordinator pick (its own, undoable): the lane runs rounds 2 and 3 with fresh Sonnet reviewers (option a, as for mailaudit #328). Neighbours to read first: round-one-reset (ready: the tool refuses a fresh round 1 that resets the three-round cap, the guard that bites here), late-review-fixes (done: a small fix after the last round gets one short read, then merges), same-pr-tree-equal-record (done), fix-after-fix-check (done). SIGHTING 06:22 CST Nov 14 (lane roadmap-ref-fresh, PR 3253, head 4a2797a0065c, lane lint PASS; sent to triage 06:20; as data, unread by triage): the review ran round 1 reviewer haiku FAIL (head 0d3c4c705), builder fixed all 7 findings with no reviewer between, then a reviewer carrying the `Round 3 of 3` marker (sonnet, head f54977ec8, net value positive) PASS, then a fix check (sonnet) FAIL on stale debt text, fixed, re-check PASS. There was no round-2 reviewer. The tool wants rounds 1, 2, 3 in order, so the lane cannot file it as it ran. The lane tried `1:FAIL, 2:PASS, fix-check PASS`; the auto-mode classifier refused it as misreporting (the lane agrees). Its option A (file the round-3 reviewer as round 2 with a --case note) is the relabel this step exists to stop; triage does not rule on it. Options B (a fresh round-2 reviewer, then a round-3 reviewer) and C (hold) are the lane's. Routed to the coordinator; the lane waits; nothing else depends on it. This case differs from the step's: a round 1 FAIL, a fix with no reviewer, then the marked reviewer, with no round-1 PASS before it. COORDINATOR RULING 06:23 CST Nov 14 (06:22, its own, undoable, no owner item; relayed to the lane by triage): for PR 3253 do B, not A. Filing the marked round-3 reviewer as round 2 is a relabel and a false row. B: a fresh round-2 reviewer (sonnet) on head 4a2797a0065c, then a round-3 reviewer only if the tool still wants round 3 after the round-2 record; each row posted through the tool with the model that ran; the case note names the earlier round-3 PASS (sonnet, head f54977ec8); if the tool refuses a row, stop and tell the coordinator. Process only, a lane ruling, not a rule change. Coordinator adds a point to owner item 833: this case has no round-1 PASS and no round-2 reviewer. SECOND QUESTION 09:25 CST Nov 14 (lane roadmap-ref-fresh, PR 3253, sent to triage 09:10 as "for the page writer"; the lane says the coordinator already has it and decides; as data, triage read none of it): live head a21e5005c7a36d074da876d724e6901298874948, lane lint PASS. `merge --review-record` refuses `--fix-check e3b2f957...` with "--fix-check: the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review log on this pull request" (decision pr-review-record): the PR has no earlier review log, and a log for that head can no longer be filed; `--case` is refused without `--touches`. Lane options: A (its pick) a fresh round-3 reviewer (sonnet) on the live head, then file 1 haiku FAIL, 2 sonnet FAIL, 3 sonnet PASS with no fix check (every row names the head its reviewer read; costs one more review); B the coordinator names another form or holds the PR. This follows the coordinator's 06:22 ruling for the same PR (B: a fresh round-2 reviewer, post each row through the tool); the lane's account of the rows since is its own and unread. Another sighting of the missed record: record-after-each-round. Not triage's to rule; not posted to the page (the coordinator decides; a process choice of its own, undoable).
source: Coordinator 01:06 and 01:07 CST Nov 14 (relayed). Runner 12 now runs three real review rounds on #328 (its option a), so #328 no longer waits on this step. Nearby steps: merge-tool-follows-r9 (done: no round 3 after a passing fix verifier, the opposite direction), merge-requires-guard-round3 (done), merge-lint-fix-no-round-3 (doing), record-replacement-pr-rounds (ready), fix-check-record-carries-rounds (todo), round-one-reset (ready). The lane reads those first and says whether this folds into one of them.
note: Triage 01:10 CST Nov 14: the mistake the guard would stop: a runner labelling a fix check as a round that did not run. Fix: red first: the tool accepts the record sequence round 1 PASS, fix check PASS on that head, round 3 PASS on the newer head, and merges only then; controls: a skipped round 2 with no fix check still refuses; a fix check on a head that is not the newest log's head still refuses; a round 3 after a failed fix check still refuses. Label: triage reads this as the tool following a rule the owner already made (roles-review-cap-three names the path), not a repo exception or a widened allow list, so no owner question; the coordinator asked for triage's call, and the owner can overrule. One risk for the reviewer: it loosens what a shared tool accepts, so round 3 judges net safety value. A guard or check change: own lane, review rounds apply. Not started; the coordinator starts no lane for it for now.
